content:
United Independent School District recognized three outgoing trustees for their service at a recent board meeting, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The trustees honored were Frank J. "Tano" Montemayor, Juan Roberto "Bobby" Flores and Gilbert "Gil" Oliveros, the Times reported.

The recognition marked the end of their service on the board that oversees one of the largest school districts in the region, serving students across Laredo and Webb County.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, November 2026.
